messages:
alex: noticed an error in staging logs where a customer support script printed a blob that decodes to a SA JSON. not in prod but probably leaked from a local dev upload. tagging sec and infra.
pepper: :eyes: can you paste redacted log line and the base64 prefix? we need to confirm SA email and scope.
alex: redacted: `support-script: uploaded payload=***` base64 prefix: `ewogICJ0eXBlIjogInNlcnZpY2VfYWNjb3VudCIsCiAgImNsaWVudF9lbWFpbCI6ICJyb3J5QHJlZHBvb2QtdGVzdC5jb20iLAogICJwcm9qZWN0X2lkIjogInJlZHdvZC1zdGFnaW5nIiwKICAicHJpdmF0ZV9rZXlfaWQiOiAiMTEyMjMzIgp9`
vault-bot: [Alert] sensitive-blob-detected channel=support-scripts env=staging pattern=base64_gcp_sa_key ticket=SEC-5502
pepper: decode shows `serviceAccount: rory@redwood-test.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. shortlist keys and revoke if present.
alex: running: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=rory@redwood-test.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-test --format=json` -> no active keys listed (maybe rotated earlier). still scan artifacts and logs.
pepper: still treat as exposure. create temporary detection rule to quarantine uploads containing SA JSON and block support script uploading raw payloads. infra-bot can you add a rule?
infra-bot: [Task] created log-processor rule staging: quarantine_on_sa_json assigned=infra-team ticket=OPS-1310
pepper: also check Vault for any plaintext entries under `secret/support/*` and legacy paths. we should avoid storing any plaintext SA JSONs.
vault-bot: [Action] running vault-scan for pattern `\"type\": \"service_account\"` under secret/ (partial results queued) ticket=SEC-5502
alex: I found two local test artifacts uploaded to gs://dev-uploads with keyfile names. grep shows `partner-fixtures/*` and `support/test-fixtures/*`. scheduling artifact sweep.
pepper: plan: 1) sweep artifacts and delete offending files 2) rotate any keys that were actually active 3) recommend envelope-encrypt + Vault-ciphertext flow for dev/support workflows 4) add pre-commit + CI blockers for SA JSON patterns 5) notify compliance if partner keys present.
sec-oncall: please notify compliance and run SOC monitoring for staging egress. I'll enable alerts.
compliance: acknowledged. provide timeline and artifact list in SEC-5502. note: developer-origin leaks require dev training follow-up.
pepper: short developer-friendly flow to avoid plaintext in dev: use helper `dev-key-wrap` script that 1) creates SA key locally, 2) calls `gcloud kms encrypt` with `projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/dev/key=dev-wrap`, 3) uploads ciphertext to Vault at `secret/dev/<name>/wrapped` and deletes local keyfile. sample:
```
# create key to stdout and pipe to kms encrypt
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create - --iam-account=dev-sa@redwood-test.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-test | \ 
  gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=dev --key=dev-wrap --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- > key.enc
vault kv put secret/dev/dev-sa wrapped=@key.enc && shred -u key.enc
```
pepper: also tighten KMS IAM: ensure only `infra-decryptor@redwood-ops.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `group:ops@redwood` have decrypt role. run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy dev-wrap --keyring=dev --location=global --project=redwood-kms` and remove legacy principals.
infra-bot: [Info] created OPS-1311 to run IAM policy audit on keyRing=dev and remove broad principals.
alex: artifact sweep removing 5 files from gs://dev-uploads and support fixtures. rotational checklist: if a leaked key was used, revoke and create new + wrap. otherwise note exposure and close.
pepper: add runbook snippet and a quick checklist to onboarding docs so support/dev teams know to use KMS+Vault for generated keys and not commit or upload raw JSONs. schedule a 30-min training.
sec-oncall: SOC alerts enabled for staging egress and unknown outbound IPs. oncall monitoring will keep channel updated.
compliance: once SEC-5502 has artifact list and any revoked key ids, I'll advise on next steps. please include any partner contacts if partner keys implicated.
pepper: post-incident actions: - artifact sweep (OPS-1310) - IAM KMS audit (OPS-1311) - vault-scan & migrate plaintext to ciphertext-only (SEC-5502) - CI/pre-commit block rules - dev training + runbook update - tabletop next sprint.
alex: timeline: detected 2001112223, artifact sweep started 2001113600, scans + KMS audit scheduled 2001117200. closing notes to SEC-5502 once sweep completes. thanks all. :thumbsup:
